blurb: Overlooking the Potomac River and Catoctin Mountain Range, the 18th century style home was built by the owner's grandparents, Mr. and Mrs. Stirling Murray Rust, and is listed on the National Register of Historic Landmarks and the Virginia Landmark Register. It is framed by mature oak trees, bountiful gardens, rustic outbuildings and pastoral vistas which provide the perfect backdrop for you special day.
